title: East Coast or North Coast: Choosing Your Zanzibar Beach
excerpt: The north and east coasts of Zanzibar feel very different. Tides, atmosphere and activities: which beach suits you?
body:
Choosing where to stay on Zanzibar is mainly a choice between the north and the east coast.

## North coast: Nungwi and Kendwa

- Small tidal differences: you can swim at most times of day.
- Lively, with restaurants and bars.
- Beautiful sunsets over the sea.
- Busier.

See [Nungwi and Kendwa](/blog/nungwi-and-kendwa/).

## East coast: Paje, Jambiani, Bwejuu, Michamvi, Matemwe

- Large tidal differences: at low tide the sea retreats far.
- Quiet, wide beaches.
- Kitesurfing in Paje.
- Seaweed farms and village life.

See [kitesurfing in Paje](/blog/kitesurfing-paje/) and [Michamvi](/blog/michamvi-sunsets/).

## Northeast: Matemwe and Kiwengwa

Close to [Mnemba Atoll](/blog/mnemba-atoll-snorkelling/) for snorkelling and diving.

## Southwest

Fumba and Menai Bay for [Safari Blue](/blog/safari-blue-zanzibar/) and dolphins.

## Our tip

Combine one night in Stone Town with several nights on the beach. [Plan your Zanzibar stay](/travel-proposal/).
